description: This Rust source file defines structures and functions for handling the '+renew' command, including parsing arguments, renewing subscriptions, and filtering subscriptions based on expiration times.

classes.name: RenewConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for the renew command, including optional name, all flag, and within duration.

methods.name: parse_renew_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to produce a RenewConfig object, ensuring either --name or --all is specified.

methods.name: handle_renew
methods.description: Main handler for the '+renew' command; renews specific or all subscriptions based on arguments.

methods.name: filter_subscriptions_to_renew
methods.description: Filters a list of subscriptions to identify those expiring within a specified duration.

methods.name: parse_duration
methods.description: Converts a duration string like '1h', '30m', '2d' into seconds.

methods.name: parse_rfc3339_rough
methods.description: Parses an RFC 3339 timestamp string into Unix epoch seconds.
